acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is generally recommended to sign up in advance for structured group workouts at our Santa Clarita location. Pre-registration helps us manage class sizes, ensure adequate equipment availability, and allows coaches to prepare for the session. Checking the class schedule online or via our app and reserving your spot is the best practice to guarantee your participation and avoid disappointment, especially for popular class times.
